function.name: send_info_email
function.description: Email information to the caller. A verified caller's goes to the address already on their account; a new caller whose details were confirmed on this call can be sent only the steps to start a claim, at the address they gave. Call it after the caller said yes to having it emailed. Never takes an address. Its result is the sentence for the caller: already spoken, or read out word for word when spoken is false.

topic.description: document_checklist for the documents a claim still needs and how to send them; claim_summary for the status of every claim; how_to_start_claim for the steps to start a new claim.

messages.content: One moment, let me check on that.
Thanks for bearing with me, almost there.
Sorry, that email didn't go through just now. You can find the same information at observeinsurance dot com slash claims, or I can have a representative send it. Which would you prefer?
